movement.instructions: Choose movement. Normally run right. If blocked_forward and wall.height_above_feet_px is greater than ceiling_clearance_px, move left off the platform to reach the passage below. During a left retreat, continue left until feet_y is at least32 greater than movement_origin_feet_y (Mario has dropped below the ledge); then return right. Increasing feet_y means downward.

criteria.run_right: Continue right, or resume right after dropping below the ledge.
criteria.brake_left: Retreat left off a ledge that blocks the route.

criteria.B: The enemy is far away: more than three body lengths ahead.
criteria.C: The enemy is close: within three body lengths.

criteria.C: The enemy is close: within two body lengths.

wall.instructions: Classify whether the wall requires a jump now. A wall taller than ceiling_clearance_px cannot be jumped over from here.

criteria.B: The wall is more than three body lengths away, or cannot be cleared because its height exceeds ceiling clearance.
criteria.C: The wall is within three body lengths and there is enough clearance to jump over it.
